title: he Hubble Sphere Radiation Pressure Law is Consistent With the Cosmological Redshift z = Sqrt( R_H/R_t) − 1
content: Haug and Wojnow [1] have recently demonstrated that there exists a law for the Hubble sphere very similar to the Ideal Gas Law, which they have called the Hubble Sphere Radiation Pressure Law. In this paper, we will demonstrate that the Haug and Tatum cosmologicalredshift: z = Sqrt( R_H/R_t) − 1 can be derived from their framework.
